scenarios.name: Visit Home without leaving an active sketch

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
the user chooses Home from the View tab's Switch menu
the Home workspace displays its recent documents
the part remains available in the document tab strip
the user selects the part's document tab
the part's sketch viewport and model browser are displayed
the sketch editing environment remains active
